title: CausalEvolve: Towards Open-Ended Discovery with Causal Scratchpad

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided evolutionary coding for open-ended scientific discovery
mechanism.populationDetail: CausalEvolve is evaluated on an evolutionary coding scaffold, but its maintained population layout is not specified.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The paper does not describe an elite archive or its admission rule.
mechanism.replacementDetail: ShinkaEvolve is the main baseline; its population details cannot be assumed to transfer to this method.
mechanism.generationDetail: The child uses a parent and selected inspiration programs, but edit scope and whether inspirations are genealogical parents are not specified.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Factor descriptors and approximate treatment-effect estimates are scratchpad signals; they are not all direct evaluator-return fields.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Paper describes a parent plus inspiration programs but not the parent-selection source or policy.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Causal scratchpad discovers outcome/procedure factors, estimates treatment effects and abductively revises hypotheses to guide reference selection.
